BiblicalUsage: Hara is a region of Media, named once as one of the places to which the exiles were carried. In 1 Chronicles 5:26 the God of Israel stirred up the king of Assyria, and he carried the Reubenites and Gadites and the half tribe of Manasseh away to Halah and Habor and Hara and the river Gozan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is a sober reminder that exile has an address: real people were carried to real places, and God kept count of every one of them.
